correctness.rationale: The reduced oriented-simplex trace formula is reconstructed, including the empty-face sign. The all-graph Mycielski cancellation gives the negative Lefschetz identity for any automorphism. Rotations yield degenerate 1/2-orbit cases and cycle quotient; reflections yield precisely three path quotients. Classical ordinary suspension and cycle homotopy formulas concentrate reduced homology in exactly one degree. Finite group rational averaging yields the mod-12 geometric quotient statement. Actual checker file provides 166 orbit-graph tests, 66 independent signed-face tests, and 73 quotient-average checks; these corroborate the analytic all-n proof.

originality.rationale: The strongest inspected primary results prove ordinary Mycielski homotopy equivalences, not a canonical lifted D_n character. Published complete-graph and crown equivariant calculations imply only isolated cycle orders n=3 and n=6; neither covers all n>=4. The wheel-Mycielskian symmetry work concerns a different graph functor input. The explicit orbit-sign calculation plus reflected-path enumeration establishes the complete family character and a mod-12 quotient criterion. An equivariant refinement of the 2019 suspension theorem might subsume the general Lefschetz identity alone, which is not claimed as separately novel. Search results cannot certify absolute priority.
